new_matches.description: Global NetSuite Owner/Administrator - Finance Systems Manager Predominately Home Based (Roughly once a month in central London offices) £70,000 - £100,000 + Bonus & Benefits (Salary dependent on experience) Drive the future of global financial systems. An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Global Financial Systems Owner/ Administrator to join a growing international organisation in a newly created role. This position offers the chance to take ownership of a complex global financial systems landscape, supporting finance teams across more than 20 countries while driving continuous improvement, automation and operational excellence. The successful candidate will become the technical owner of several business-critical financial platforms, ensuring they remain secure, scalable and aligned with evolving business requirements. Working closely with Finance, IT and external partners, they will play a key role in delivering projects, enhancing system capabilities and supporting a global user community. The Opportunity This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with business partnering. The successful individual will oversee the administration, optimisation and ongoing development of a broad financial technology estate, whilst leading global initiatives and managing a small offshore support team. With significant exposure across multiple business functions, this role offers the opportunity to influence financial systems strategy while delivering tangible improvements to users across an international organisation. Key Responsibilities Administer, configure and maintain core financial systems, ensuring high levels of performance, security and reliability. Lead the administration and ongoing enhancement of platforms including NetSuite, Kyriba, Concur, Stripe, Ramp and integrations through Boomi . Develop, test and deploy system customisations, scripts, workflows and third-party integrations. Manage multiple global projects simultaneously, delivering enhancements and new functionality across the financial systems landscape. Lead and mentor a small offshore support team, providing technical guidance and prioritising workload. Manage NetSuite's biannual release cycle, including sandbox testing, impact assessments and production deployment. Provide second and third-line technical support, resolving complex system issues and driving continuous improvement. Design and develop custom reports, dashboards and saved searches that provide meaningful business insights. Automate business processes through workflows, approval processes and system enhancements. Collaborate with Finance and Technology teams to ensure data integrity, system stability and operational efficiency. Produce and maintain system documentation, user guides and training materials. Ensure financial systems remain compliant with internal controls, governance standards and regulatory requirements. About the Individual The successful candidate will combine strong technical capability with an excellent understanding of finance operations and business processes. They will be equally comfortable configuring enterprise systems, leading projects and engaging with stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions. They will typically bring: At least five years' experience administering and supporting NetSuite within a complex business environment. Strong knowledge of SuiteScript, workflows, saved searches, reports, forms, records and platform configuration. Experience delivering financial systems projects and managing competing priorities. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused approach. Strong understanding of financial processes and accounting principles. Experience collaborating with global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones. The ability to balance technical expertise with commercial awareness. Why Apply? Join a newly created position with genuine ownership and autonomy. Play a key role in shaping the future of a global financial systems landscape. Lead international projects supporting users across more than 20 countries. Manage a diverse portfolio of enterprise financial applications and integrations. Work closely with senior Finance and Technology leaders on strategic initiatives. Enjoy broad exposure, technical variety and excellent opportunities for long-term career development.

new_matches.title: ERP Developer
new_matches.description: About The Company Ambis Resourcing is a reputable organization specializing in providing tailored ERP solutions and consultancy services to a diverse range of clients. Known for its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, Ambis Resourcing has built a strong reputation for delivering innovative and reliable software solutions that enhance business operations. The company values its employees and fosters a collaborative and supportive work environment, which has resulted in an impressive track record of low staff turnover and long-term client partnerships. With a focus on continuous improvement and technological excellence, Ambis Resourcing remains at the forefront of ERP development and implementation, serving clients across various industries including manufacturing, logistics, and finance. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled ERP Developer to join our team on a home-based basis, offering a competitive salary of up to £60,000. This role involves working closely with clients to develop bespoke functionalities for their ERP systems using Java, JavaScript, and SQL. The primary responsibility is to translate client requirements into technical specifications and develop tailored solutions that address their unique business processes. You will act as a bridge between the client and the technical team, ensuring that the delivered solutions meet the specified needs and are aligned with best practices. The role offers flexibility in scheduling client visits, which are typically once or twice a month, and requires attendance at bi-monthly team meetings near Nottingham. This position is ideal for a developer with a strong background in ERP-related functionalities and a passion for problem-solving and client engagement. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a solid development background with recent hands-on experience in Java, JavaScript, and SQL. A strong understanding of ERP modules such as warehousing, stock management, order processing, financial reporting, manufacturing, MRP, and production is essential. Experience working within manufacturing environments or with manufacturing-related processes will be highly advantageous, enabling you to quickly adapt and contribute effectively. You should demonstrate excellent communication skills, with the ability to gather and interpret client requirements accurately, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience will also be considered. The ability to work independently and manage your own schedule is crucial for success in this role. Responsibilities Your key responsibilities will include developing custom ERP functionalities based on client specifications, creating detailed requirement documents, and providing conceptual overviews of proposed solutions. You will collaborate with clients to refine their requirements through iterative discussions and ensure that the technical implementation aligns with their business needs. You will be responsible for designing, coding, testing, and deploying bespoke features, ensuring high-quality standards and adherence to project timelines. Occasional client visits will be arranged by you, and you will maintain ongoing communication to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments. Additionally, you will participate in bi-monthly team meetings, sharing insights and learning from colleagues. Supporting the technical team and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the company will also be part of your role. Benefits Joining Ambis Resourcing offers numerous benefits, including the opportunity to work remotely with flexible scheduling, allowing you to manage your workload effectively. The role provides a competitive salary of up to £60,000, along with potential career development opportunities within a growing organization. You will be part of a highly skilled and supportive team of 12 consultants and a development team of 20, fostering an environment of learning and professional growth. The company’s strong client relationships and low staff turnover mean you will work on long-term projects with loyal clients who value quality and innovation. Additional benefits include participation in regular team meetings, ongoing training and development programs, and the chance to work on diverse and challenging projects that will enhance your skills and expertise. Equal Opportunity Ambis Resourcing is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply and join our vibrant and dynamic team.

new_matches.description: Epoch Biodesign Epoch Biodesign is a global leader in enzymatic recycling, with a unique ultra-low emission process capable of producing virgin-quality materials from mixed waste streams. Epoch is currently building Europe’s first - and the world’s largest - nylon 66 biorecycling plant. In July 2026, Epoch acquired a 52,000 tpa nylon 66 polymerisation facility in Blanes, Spain - vertically integrating the company all the way from waste to chip. Crucially, with the Blanes facility, we are now already taking orders and shipping polymer. To support our goals, we are looking for an experienced sales leader with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven ability to win new business, grow market share and build lasting customer relationships across the polyamide market within Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The Role This is a highly visible commercial leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and growing Epoch's customer portfolio, closing new business opportunities, and building strategic relationships across the polyamide value chain. This is a rare opportunity to combine deep polymer industry expertise with one of the most exciting sustainability and advanced materials platforms in the world. Key Responsibilities Commercial Growth Develop and execute commercial growth strategy for Epoch's PA66 polymer business from Blanes, Spain. Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across targeted market segments. Build and manage a robust sales pipeline and deliver against revenue and margin targets. Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, contracts, supply agreements and long-term strategic partnerships. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing dynamics and emerging opportunities. Represent Epoch at industry conferences, trade events and customer meetings. Key Account Management Develop account plans for key customers and drive growth across existing relationships. Serve as the primary commercial contact for strategic customers. Build senior-level relationships across procurement, technical, operations, sustainability and executive functions. Engage customers on sustainability, circularity and decarbonisation objectives. Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and qualification pathways. Manage customer forecasts, demand planning and business reviews. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Coordinate cross-functional support to meet customer requirements and resolve issues. Support the development of off-take agreements and long-term supply partnerships for recycled products. Internal Collaboration Work closely with existing market managers, manufacturing, supply chain, product development and leadership teams. Translate customer requirements into commercial, technical and production priorities. Provide market intelligence to support business planning and investment decisions. Contribute to product portfolio strategy and market positioning. Required Experience Significant commercial experience within the polyamide 66 market, nylon yarn and engineering plastics. Existing relationships with major customers, compounders, yarn spinners, nylon distributors and downstream customers and users. Proven track record in both account management and business development. Strong understanding of PA66 markets, applications, customers and value chains. Experience selling polymers, engineering plastics, nylon yarn, intermediates or related chemical products. Demonstrated success managing strategic customer relationships and delivering commercial growth. Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements. Strong understanding of polymer manufacturing, material specifications and customer qualification processes. Experience launching new products or developing new market segments. Exposure to sustainability, recycled materials or circular economy initiatives. Exposure to sustainability, recycled materials or circular economy initiatives. Skills and Attributes Exceptional commercial and relationship-building skills. Deep knowledge of the global PA66 industry. Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on execution mindset. Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong analytical and commercial acumen. Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally. Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building new markets. Why Join Epoch? Help build the world's first fully circular PA66 value chain. Play a pivotal role in scaling a breakthrough materials technology from early commercialisation to global deployment. Work directly with senior leadership and influence company strategy. Join a mission-driven team tackling one of the world's most important sustainability challenges. Competitive compensation package including salary, bonus and equity participation. Benefits and perks Epoch Biodesign offers a comprehensive benefits program. At the moment this includes: A generous allowance of 30 days paid holiday (plus the usual 8 bank holidays) Meaningful EMI Share Options A non-contributory pension of 9% employer contribution Optional company covered private medical insurance with Vitality Group Income Protection Group Critical Illness Flexible working around the core times of 10am to 4pm Cycle to work scheme The opportunity to be part of building something remarkable On-the-job perks Complementary fresh fruit, coffee, tea and snacks Onsite gym Various staff social activities And we’re continuously reviewing and enhancing our benefits and work environment.

new_matches.title: Business Development Lead
new_matches.description: Most companies hire to fill a seat. I am hiring because the demand outran us. 47 AI agents run in production across our ventures, Riyadh and the UK. The systems exist. The clients exist. The pipeline is growing faster than two people can feed it. The role is Business Development Lead. UK and KSA. And I will be direct about who it is for, because the wrong hire costs me a market and the right one changes what we are. You are the person who never let a good deal die of neglect. You have closed enterprise B2B in the GCC or the UK, and you know the difference between a pipeline that looks full and one that closes. You treat the CRM as a weapon, not a chore. Every other skill on my list is negotiable next to that. You are not looking for a brand name to hide behind. You are looking for an engine to run. What you get here is the opposite of the enterprise theater you have seen: no committee layers, no handoff rituals, no quarter spent writing the deck instead of shipping the work. You work directly with me and the agent fleet that builds while you sell. Production infrastructure that already exists. Clients who already pay. The commission is built on a simple fact I know from running the numbers: one great closer outearns three average salaries. I would rather pay that one person properly than pretend otherwise. Riyadh or London, hybrid. Senior package. The application is one paragraph on the deal you are proudest of. What you closed, what almost killed it, what you learned. No CV walls, no cover letters dressed as essays. I read everything myself. Usually at midnight. And yes, I reply. If this sounds like a stretch, it probably is, and we are both better off knowing now. #Hiring #BusinessDevelopment #Riyadh #London #AI
